projectName: Big brown teddy bear brittle fabric restoration
title: 30-year-old big brown teddy bear with brittle fabric, reinforced from the inside and given a new ear, paw pad, eyes and nose
description: This big brown teddy bear is more than 30 years old and arrived with holes and tears all over, a missing ear lining, a missing paw pad, no nose and only one eye. Its fur fabric had gone brittle, so every weak area was reinforced from the inside with backing fabric before it was stitched, then the bear got a new ear, paw pad, eyes, eyelashes and nose.
itemDetails: This is a large, soft brown teddy bear with shaggy fur, a cream-coloured muzzle, cream inner ears and cream paw pads. It has black eyes with black eyelashes, a black nose and a small red tongue, and it is filled with soft stuffing. It is more than 30 years old.
repairDetails: When the bear arrived, one ear had lost its whole white inner part, one paw pad was gone, the nose and one eye were missing, and there were holes and tears all over. All of the stuffing came out first. The bear had been repaired before by the owner's mum, so old black clumped stuffing was mixed with newer polyester. The old stuffing was thrown away, and the polyester was cleaned to go back in. The empty bear had a deep clean and was dried outside. Turned inside out, the real problem showed: after more than 30 years the fur fabric had gone brittle, and like an old sweater it fell apart as soon as it was pulled, so stitching on top alone would just tear through again. Every weak area got a backing fabric underneath, ironed on with fusible web or glued with fabric glue, on the front and the back. A new ear lining and paw pad were made from white fur fabric that matches the originals and sewn on by hand. Both eyes were replaced, new eyelashes were cut from black felt to match the originals, and a new nose was added. The bear was restuffed with the cleaned stuffing, every hole and tear was stitched closed, and it was finished with an orange ribbon. At the owner's request, the bear also got to wear her wedding veil.
